name: @aparadeckav2/tooling
description: Root tooling shell: git hooks (husky + lint-staged) and repo-wide dependency scripts. Studio and web remain independent packages with their own lockfiles.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck --prefix studio && npm run check --prefix web
scripts.deps:install-clean: npm ci && npm ci --prefix studio && npm ci --prefix web
scripts.deps:lock-regenerate: rm -f package-lock.json studio/package-lock.json web/package-lock.json && npm install --package-lock-only && npm install --package-lock-only --prefix studio && npm install --package-lock-only --prefix web
scripts.deps:bump: ncu --target semver -u && ncu --target semver -u --cwd studio && ncu --target semver -u --cwd web && npm run deps:lock-regenerate && npm run deps:install-clean
